title: Hearing an old record with Doc Souchon; who made it
summary: Leclerc was glad to hear Doc Souchon sing on an old record he had forgotten. They guess its date and discuss the company that issued it; Leclerc has never seen the record.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yeah, well, I'll just ask you some questions off the top of my head.
I was so anxious, I was so glad to hear Doc Seuss singing Mark Korky. I hadn't even remembered that. He sang it very well.
I think that record was made about... Ooh, just imagine. 65 or something like that. Oh, must have.
No, before that. Must have been before that. Yeah, I'm sure it would.
And it's hard to find now. Yeah. I know the head of that company, I guess. He's a friend of mine. He used to play tennis sax with Joe Venuti.
I can't remember his name. I'll look it up, though.
I got it in the book. You know, they list all the different people.
And you never had seen that record before or anything?
No, no. Which one do you mean? The one right there with Ed Maugh. Oh, no, no, no.
I really don't have it. First time I've seen it, I heard it.
